name: genesis_voice_request
description: Record what the caller is asking for. Genesis queues it and returns immediately — this does NOT run any work and does not produce an answer during the call. The response carries `followUp`, which is the ONLY thing that tells you what to say about what happens next. Read it and say exactly that; never decide for yourself that someone will get back to them.

request_body_schema.description: The caller's request, in their own words.

callerId.description: The caller's phone number, verbatim from the telephony provider.

request.description: What the caller asked for, in their own words. Summarize only if they rambled; do not add anything they did not say.

conversationId.description: This call's conversation id. Passing it makes a retried tool call land on the same ticket instead of creating a duplicate.
